“Cheating and explaining the answer [to your child] are closer than you’d think.” Here’s my new episode with @suekhim, co-founder of @brilliantorg, who showed me how AI can help kids think for themselves. We talked about: → Why better grades don’t always mean more learning → How to help kids enjoy doing hard things vs. only trying to please adults → Why her #1 product principle is “Never tell the learner the answer” Some quotes from Sue: “Using AI to skip learning is like bringing a robotic arm to the gym to lift weights for you.” “Learning isn’t about the answer.
